page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 7H12 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The absence of integrated local storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing high-capacity RAM allocation and dedicated CPU resources over local disk I/O and hardware-accelerated graphics processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r6a.16xlarge offers a high density of memory relative to compute resources, making it a viable option for workloads that require large in-memory footprints without the overhead of paying for unneeded local storage or GPU accelerators. This profile is suitable for hosting large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
